Care built around children and parents

Children Need a Different Kind of Consultation

Children may not always be able to describe how they feel. Our doctors take time to listen, observe and understand both the child’s needs and the parent’s concerns.

A familiar, child-friendly approach also helps families build continuity of care as children grow.

How we can help

Paediatric-Focused Primary Care

Care is guided by a doctor’s assessment, your child’s age and their individual health and developmental needs.

Fever & Common Childhood Illnesses

Assessment and advice for fever, flu-like symptoms and other common illnesses.

Cough, Cold & Respiratory Symptoms

Evaluation of common cough, cold and breathing-related concerns.

Gastrointestinal Conditions

Care for vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach discomfort and related concerns.

Skin Conditions

Assessment of common rashes, irritation and everyday skin concerns.

Vaccinations

Immunisation guidance based on age, needs and current availability.

Growth & Development

Support for questions about growth, development and milestones.

Everyday Child Health Advice

Practical guidance to help parents make informed next-step decisions.
